احتكروا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَكَرُوا (iḥtakarū) /iħ.ta.ka.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# اُحْتُكِرُوا (uḥtukirū) /uħ.tu.ki.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# اِحْتَكِرُوا (iḥtakirū) /iħ.ta.ki.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
